name: FDD review assigned to Ben
trigger: a client tracker assigns Ben an FDD to review or size

steps.name: Ingest
steps.means: Ben is assigned an FDD to review; master tasks a read.

steps.name: Read FDD and code
steps.means: The client agent reads the FDD and the code behind it.

sla.why: refit to p75 of 5 observed stays (2026-11-15; Ben 2026-11-15)

steps.name: Findings and questions
steps.means: The client agent writes up findings and questions as a document.
steps.gate: HTML or the Logan format; never Markdown

spec.read_first: coord_get_task_result {prev} (the step before this one in case {case}: {root_title}).
constraints: Format: HTML, or .docx where the FDD format is defined. Never Markdown.

steps.name: Review
steps.means: A fresh agent checks the document against its checklist.

steps.name: Promote
steps.means: The board promotes the approved document to deliverables; if it refuses, Ben clicks Promote.
steps.gate: auto-promoted when the dod_review approves (auto_promote switch); Promote on /deliverables if refused

steps.name: Reply or tracker comment
steps.means: The client agent drafts the email or tracker comment that carries the findings; nothing is sent.

steps.name: Send or paste
steps.means: Ben sends the email or pastes the comment; that closes the case.

sla.why: refit to p75 of 8 observed stays (2026-11-15; Ben 2026-11-15)
